description:
Creates a MySQL user for the domain's database and grants it the privileges of the chosen role.

HTTP: POST /v1/databases
Category: Databases
Required scopes: databases:write
Returns: {status, data: any}
Mutating: changes server state.

domain_id.description: UUID of the domain whose database the user is granted on — obtain it from GET /v1/domains

username.description: MySQL user name to create (unique on the server)

name: panelica_databases_post_v1_databases
